gaps.whyImportant: Major high-altitude world landscape gap for ERN with exceptional visual value and low representation from Central Asia.
researchEvidence: Official Tajikistan/Pamir references confirm Murghab, Khorog, Karakul Lake, the Wakhan Valley and the Pamir Highway as high-value target landscapes.
Current Tajik hydrometeorology and Murghab district sites provide official regional/weather information but no source-specific scenic live feed suitable for ERN.
Windfinder's Murghab webcam page currently reports that no nearby webcams are available.
Current web searches surface prerecorded Pamir travel films and generic camera directories, but no sufficiently trustworthy always-current scenic Pamir camera.
disallowedShortcuts: Do not use prerecorded YouTube travel films as LIVE.
Do not infer live status from generic Tajikistan webcam directories.
Do not promote a weather iframe as a scenic live camera without source-specific moving/current imagery.
nextResearch: Continue checking official Pamir/GBAO tourism, Khorog and Murghab local-government pages, hydrometeorological stations, hotels/guesthouses, road operators and high-altitude research stations.
Prefer Khorog, Murghab, Karakul Lake, Wakhan Valley or a Pamir Highway weather/road camera if a source-specific current feed appears.
Do not substitute adjacent Kyrgyzstan/Kazakhstan cameras for the unresolved Tajikistan/Pamir gap.

gaps.whyImportant: ERN now has broad Europe/Asia/Americas coverage but still lacks strong scenic current/quasi-live representation across the Middle East and North Africa.
researchEvidence: Official tourism/government pages for Oman, Jordan, Qatar and Morocco provide strong destination material but recent searches did not surface sufficiently trustworthy scenic current cameras suitable for immediate promotion.
Virtual tours and prerecorded destination films are intentionally excluded from LIVE/current semantics.

2026-10-04 research found current strong-provider live pages for Petra (Treasury + Visitor Center) and Muscat Aida Beach; these are now playback-gated candidates. Marrakech/Koutoubia and Tahanaout provider pages were observed OFFLINE and were not promoted.
disallowedShortcuts: Do not use virtual tours as current cameras.
Do not use generic weather widgets as scenic Earth windows.
Do not treat prerecorded tourism video as quasi-live.
nextResearch: Prefer official tourism, port, airport, municipality, observatory or resort current-image feeds.
Use quasi-live/current-image semantics when timestamped still imagery is reliable.

gaps.region: South Pacific islands beyond current Cook Islands coverage
gaps.whyImportant: ERN has strong New Zealand/Australia coverage and a Cook Islands foothold, but broader Pacific island coverage remains thin.
researchEvidence: Official meteorological sources are useful for weather/radar but generally do not provide scenic Earth imagery suitable for ERN.
A current Fiji resort webcam was found under maintenance and therefore was not promoted.

2026-10-04 research found first-party live webcam pages at Plantation Island Resort and Lomani Island Resort on Malolo Lailai, Fiji; both are playback-gated candidates. Vomo Island's webcam page explicitly says the camera is under maintenance, so it was not queued as current.
disallowedShortcuts: Do not use radar loops as scenic camera substitutes.
Do not count static resort marketing images as quasi-live without timestamp/freshness evidence.
nextResearch: Prefer tourism boards, ports, airports, councils and resorts with timestamped refreshed scenic images or live video.

gaps.whyImportant: ERN aggregate search telemetry recorded a Chiang Mai search with no result. A trustworthy current city or scenic window would close a real observed visitor-discovery gap.
researchEvidence: Fresh public research found Chiang Mai Provincial Administrative Organization real-time CCTV surfaces, but the visible camera cards were in STANDBY / WAITING FOR FEED and therefore are not suitable for ERN current promotion.
Tourism Authority of Thailand provides authoritative Chiang Mai destination context but not a current scenic camera on the destination page.
No weak directory, prerecorded video or generic weather view should be substituted for a verified current Chiang Mai window.
disallowedShortcuts: Do not label STANDBY/WAITING FOR FEED camera cards as live.
Do not use prerecorded Chiang Mai travel video as a current window.
Do not use a city-information page without current imagery as a camera source.
nextResearch: Recheck Chiang Mai PAO/municipal smart-city camera surfaces for an actually moving or reliably refreshed public feed.
Check official university, park, airport, river/traffic and attraction sources for a source-specific current view.
Prefer one strong canonical Chiang Mai place rather than many traffic-camera records.

gaps.region: Hua Hin / Dolphin Bay / Prachuap Khiri Khan
gaps.whyImportant: ERN aggregate search telemetry recorded Hua Hin and repeated Dolphin Bay / Thailand zero-result searches. This is a real visitor-demand cluster, not an editorial guess.
researchEvidence: Tourism Authority of Thailand currently provides authoritative Hua Hin destination and beach information.
Fresh research did not establish a trustworthy source-specific current scenic camera for Hua Hin or Dolphin Bay suitable for ERN promotion.
Thailand Department of Highways exposes current traffic/CCTV infrastructure, but a scenic destination-specific Hua Hin/Dolphin Bay public feed was not verified.
disallowedShortcuts: Do not use static tourism images as CURRENT IMAGE.
Do not substitute a generic highway camera for a scenic destination unless the exact place and current feed are verified.
Do not use prerecorded beach video as LIVE.
nextResearch: Check official municipality, harbour, resort, beach-safety, marine, weather and attraction sources for a stable Hua Hin or Dolphin Bay current view.
Prefer one strong canonical destination source over many low-value traffic feeds.
